title: Twingate or a Traditional VPN Client: Zero Trust Access for Remote Teams
excerpt: Twingate grants remote users access to specific resources rather than the whole network. A traditional VPN client usually connects users to the network as a whole. This comparison weighs security, effort and cost.
verdict: Twingate is the stronger choice for security and ease of management for modern remote teams, since it applies least-privilege access per resource without exposing a VPN gateway to the internet. A traditional VPN can still be the cheaper option for a very small team that is comfortable running its own server.
